Name: More Than Forage - Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: RydelTheOtter
Description:
Changes the internal categories for forage added by Stardew Valley Expanded to allow refinement with Kegs, Preserve Jars, and Dehydrators. Meant to be paired with Cheerbelle's More Than Forage.

[b]Covered Items
[/b][list]
[*]Thistle (Flower by default)
[*]Ferngill Primrose (Flower by default)
[*]Four Leaf Clover (Vegetable by default)
[*]Smelly Rafflesia (Flower by default)
[*]Goldenrod (Flower by default)
[*]Poison Mushroom (Unchanged by default due to being poisonous)
[*]Red Baneberry (Unchanged by default due to being poisonous)
[*]Mushroom Colony (Mushroom by default)
[*]Bearberry (Fruit by default)
[*]Winter Star Rose (Flower by default)
[*]Diamond Flower (Flower by default)
[*]Dewdrop Berry (Fruit by default)
[*]Swamp Flower (Flower by default)
[*]Conch (Unchanged by default)
[*]Sand Dollar (Unchanged by default)
[*]Shark Tooth (Unchanged by default)
[*]Golden Ocean Flower (Flower by default)
[*]Dulse Seaweed (Unchanged by default)
[*]Green Mushrrom (Mushroom by default)
[*]Mega Purple Mushroom (Mushroom by default)
[/list]
In addition to the categories used by More Than Forage, More Than Forage SVE also can tag items as Mushrooms, which can be dried by Dehydrators

[b]Config Presets
[/b]For users who are using More Than Forage's config presets, two Config Presets are included to match behavior of the similarly named presets in the original mod: Author, and Vegetable

Downloads.Description:
Fixed incorrect Scheme version causing loading issues
Fixed Mushroom not being valid for Green Mushrooms, Mega Mushrooms, and Dulse Seaweed
